title: PONG PING
models: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) wrote the code, the assets and the critiques
Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) built the four halls, the rally music, the pencil mode, match point and the match report
no image or sound generator: every sound is synthesised at runtime from the physics
what_i_found: The rally is the music: every contact plays a note that climbs a scale over a beat locked to the rally's own tempo, and past a dozen shots the hall redraws itself in pencil while only the table, the ball and the two blades keep their colour. The racket is real, not a bat: a 2.7 g ball with drag and Magnus lift meets rubber modelled as grip and slip, so spin is a control, a flick at contact or a sweep of the mouse while your serve is in the air, and you watch the ball curve with it. Each opponent plays in a hall of its own, from a school gym in daylight to a floodlit arena, and the game meets a nearly-right stroke halfway instead of making the opponent worse, so anyone can rally and PRO still bites.
